''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' places the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which served as the zero point of a [[Unidentified calendar (Treaty of Coruscant)|calendar]] adopted by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] following the conclusion of the [[Great Galactic War]] per {{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Galactic History|int=Galactic Timeline}}, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], which was based around the date of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Thus, the difference between the two dating systems is 3,653 years.<noinclude>
